n832c349ef5.headline: Greek stock exchange board picks Kontopoulos as new CEO
n832c349ef5.summary: The board of Hellenic Exchanges, operator of Greece's stock and equity derivatives markets, picked Yiannos Kontopoulos as its new CEO. The appointment was reported by Reuters.
n832c349ef5.why: Hellenic Exchanges runs the Athens stock exchange and its derivatives market. Leadership changes at market operators can shape strategy and listing policy.

nabde8b3a52.headline: Bitcoin pyramid schemes wreak havoc on Brazil
nabde8b3a52.summary: Brazil's federal police raided a seaside hotel helipad in Rio de Janeiro state in April, arresting two men and a woman. The article describes bitcoin pyramid schemes affecting Brazil.
nabde8b3a52.why: Bitcoin is a decentralised cryptocurrency, and fraudulent schemes built around it erode investor confidence and draw regulatory scrutiny in emerging markets.

n65a8060a48.headline: Nigeria lost N74.51bn oil revenue in December, says OPEC
n65a8060a48.summary: OPEC reports Nigeria lost 74.51 billion naira in oil revenue in December 2021 due to a significant drop in crude oil production.
n65a8060a48.why: Nigeria is a major oil producer in Africa; production declines impact government revenues and global oil supply considerations.

n9cff759e4d.headline: Housing prices rose more than 15% in 2021 | FaceNews.ua: news from Ukraine
n9cff759e4d.summary: Housing prices in Ukraine increased by an average of 15.8% in Q4 2021 compared to the same period in 2020.
n9cff759e4d.why: Rising housing prices indicate real estate market strength and inflationary pressures, relevant for investors and policymakers in Ukraine.

nd1137fd7a0.headline: IPC has worst week in more than a year | Zócalo Newspaper | News from Saltillo, Torreón, Piedras Negras, Monclova, Acuña
nd1137fd7a0.summary: The S&P/BMV IPC index of the Mexican Stock Exchange recorded its largest accumulated loss in 15 months this week.
nd1137fd7a0.why: The S&P/BMV IPC is Mexico's main stock market index, reflecting investor sentiment and economic conditions in Latin America's second-largest economy.
